clue.text: A colourful setting for any pupil

definitions.text: A colourful setting for any pupil

parts.words: A colourful setting for any pupil
parts.note: the pupil is not a schoolchild but the dark centre of the eye, and the coloured ring around it is its setting

explanation.surface: Somewhere bright and cheerful for a schoolchild to learn in.
explanation.definitionFit: The coloured ring of the eye surrounds the pupil like a mount around a gem.

clue.text: Soon producing a negative

parts.note: non is a negating word, as in non-starter

explanation.surface: Something that will soon give a refusal.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is an old word for shortly or in a little while.

clue.text: Some believe totally in prohibition

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A number of people wholeheartedly support banning things.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'in prohibition' cannot stand in for the answer; 'in' is a link word and 'prohibition' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A veto is a ban or refusal blocking something from happening.

clue.text: He dreams of a tall architect-designed structure, right?

parts.note: a spire is a tall tapering structure on a church

explanation.surface: Someone imagines a lofty building, asking for confirmation.
explanation.definitionFit: One with ambitions, someone hoping to reach high, is a dreamer of what might be.

clue.text: Notice a government official's conduct

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
a minister is a senior government official

explanation.surface: Observe the behaviour of a civil servant.
explanation.definitionFit: To administer affairs is to manage or run them, a verb sense of conduct.

clue.text: Royal ladies can bring crowds outside into the cold

indicators.note: outside says the crowds word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: presses are crowds or throngs
into gives the short word in
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: Queens' daughters draw throngs even out in freezing weather.
explanation.definitionFit: The daughters of a monarch are female royals of high rank.

clue.text: Offering small pastry with fish is quite unexpected

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a tart is a pastry case with filling
a ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Serving a little tart alongside fish is a surprising choice.
explanation.definitionFit: Startling describes something so surprising it makes one jump.

clue.text: Putting five hundred in additionally creates a stir

indicators.note: Putting ... in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: too means as well, additionally
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: Adding five hundred more causes a commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a fuss or commotion.

clue.text: Will change 13 across

indicators.note: change tells us to rearrange the letters of the other entry

parts.note: the solution to 13 across, an account

explanation.surface: Instruction to alter a last will.
explanation.definitionFit: A last will and testament is the legal document disposing of one's estate.

clue.text: The plant getting a loan isn't broke

indicators.note: broke signals the letters are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A plant that is not penniless after receiving credit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broke' looks like the penniless sense, but it is the anagram signal on A LOAN ISNT.
explanation.definitionFit: Santolina, cotton lavender, is a grey-leaved aromatic shrub.

clue.text: Child going up & down

indicators.note: in a down entry the word reads the same going up the grid as coming down

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A youngster bouncing about.
explanation.definitionFit: A tot is a small child.

clue.text: Cutting error

explanation.surface: A wrong snip.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip is a plant cutting used for propagation, and also a small mistake.

clue.text: The quitter keeping a sailing man back

indicators.note: back says the sailor word is read in reverse

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: The deserter holds a seaman at the rear.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat is one who deserts a cause, as rats are said to leave a sinking ship.

clue.text: Account for 8 down making changes

indicators.note: making changes tells us to rearrange the letters of the other entry

parts.note: the solution to 8 down, a will

explanation.surface: Explaining a will by revising it.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a written or spoken account of facts.

clue.text: Pedantic but chic, as lots may be

indicators.note: may be suggests the letters could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Fussy but stylish, as many might be.
explanation.definitionFit: Scholastic can mean narrowly academic, overly concerned with fine points.

clue.text: Out-of-the-ordinary police work

explanation.surface: Unusual detective activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Arresting means striking or remarkable, and making arrests is what officers do.

clue.text: Photographers' affairs divulged by a blabbermouth

explanation.surface: A gossip spills the secrets of camera people.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposures are the frames taken on film, and also revelations of secrets.

clue.text: A number brought in to help will be acrimonious

indicators.note: brought in says the number goes inside the help word

parts.note: aid means to help
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a number

explanation.surface: Calling in a number of helpers will lead to bitterness.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid remarks are sharp and bitter.

clue.text: Crack is dividing those people giving remedial treatment

indicators.note: is dividing says the crack word splits the other piece in two

parts.note: they refers to those people
a rap is a sharp blow or crack

explanation.surface: Drug use splits people needing help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crack' suggests the drug, but it is a sharp knock.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapy is healing treatment of illness or disorder.

clue.text: Getting pious fellows to see something spicy

parts.note: pi is short for pious, sanctimonious
men are fellows
taken as written

explanation.surface: Devout men visit to find something hot.
explanation.definitionFit: A pimento is a sweet red pepper, or allspice.

clue.text: A writer looking hollow eyed

explanation.surface: An author appearing gaunt.
explanation.definitionFit: H. Rider Haggard wrote King Solomon's Mines, and haggard means gaunt from worry or fatigue.

clue.text: With little cash left us

parts.note: P stands for penny, a small coin

explanation.surface: We're left with only a few pennies.
explanation.definitionFit: Plus means together with, in addition to.

clue.text: This is killing, so there's point to the hilarity

parts.note: S is south, a compass point
laughter is hilarity

explanation.surface: A comedian's routine that slays the audience with laughs.
explanation.definitionFit: Slaughter is the killing of many, or of animals for meat.

clue.text: The man holds duck deal with weeds

indicators.note: holds says one piece contains the other

parts.note: he refers to the man
O is a duck, a zero score in cricket

explanation.surface: A man holding a duck tends the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoe is to work the soil with a blade to remove weeds.

clue.text: A Greek character in doubt automatically hesitates

indicators.note: in says the answer is found within the following words

explanation.surface: Someone from Greece, unsure of themselves, pauses by reflex.
explanation.definitionFit: Tau is the nineteenth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: A holy man has one drink

parts.note: St is short for saint, a holy man
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A saint enjoys a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine.

clue.text: Rough site being transformed? That's good!

indicators.note: being transformed says the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Redeveloping a rough plot is a virtuous act.
explanation.definitionFit: Righteous means morally upright and virtuous.

clue.text: A taste for seaweed

explanation.surface: Fondness for seaweed.
explanation.definitionFit: A tang is a sharp flavour, and also a coarse kelp-like seaweed.

clue.text: Wingers can be awfully slow

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Football wide players may be painfully sluggish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wingers' looks like football wide players, but it means winged birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Owls are birds, creatures with wings.

clue.text: Kent area, note, is dry

parts.note: Kent is a county in the south-east of England, SE
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Part of Kent, it's noted, is arid.
explanation.definitionFit: Sere means withered and parched.

clue.text: Telephone circuit

explanation.surface: A phone line.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring is to phone someone, and a ring is a circular track or loop.

clue.text: Killers choked aliens carrying cash

indicators.note: carrying says the aliens word holds the cash piece

parts.note: strangers are aliens, outsiders
L stands for pound, an amount of cash

explanation.surface: Murderers throttled foreigners who had money on them.
explanation.definitionFit: Stranglers are murderers who throttle their victims.
